included: Current workspace identity and delivery policy
Active V3 development index and version layout
Read-only validation of Keco Visual Assets and V3 Player Animation Files Target Path values
Godot Windows export configuration and executable
Fresh adjacent runtime regression and delivery evidence
excluded: V1 and V2 historical evidence rewrites
Silent edits to completed V3 run logs

Gameplay, balance, visual asset bytes, paid generation, external release, Git operations, release staging, and ZIP packaging

rollback: Preserve historical records and valid Keco rows. A failed export keeps its logs and does not create release staging; a confirmed current-document error is changed only in the current index/policy files.
